about: The FPS feel checklist: every interaction a player has with a first-person shooter and what they should get from it. Items with measures are checked from a probe's timeline; the others by a person.

groups.J: Smoothness (feel breaks when the frame does)

items.name: Trigger to shot
items.expect: The shot leaves on the same frame as the press; no input delay

items.name: Muzzle flash
items.expect: A flash for one or two frames, scaled by the gun and the suppressor

items.name: Muzzle light
items.expect: A short light on the hands and the world
items.how: a person checks it in the game against 'expect' (no timeline measure yet)

items.name: Shot sound
items.expect: Layered: the report, the mechanism, a tail that changes indoors and outdoors

items.name: Visual recoil
items.expect: The gun kicks back and up, then settles, by the cartridge's energy

items.name: View climb
items.expect: The aim climbs and partly recovers; a pattern the player can learn

items.name: Camera shake on the shot
items.expect: A small, short shake, larger for big calibres

items.name: Shell ejection
items.expect: A case flies from the port, with a sound when it lands

items.name: Smoke and heat
items.expect: Smoke from the muzzle after a burst; heat shimmer on a hot barrel
